title: Pair Sum
description: Given a list of integers and a target, return the indices of two distinct values whose sum equals the target. Exactly one valid pair exists.
hints: Store information about values already visited.
For a value `x`, look for `target - x`.

solutions.title: Hash map
solutions.explanation: Scan once. Before recording the current value, check whether its complement has already been seen.

solutions.title: Brute force
solutions.explanation: Try every unordered pair and return when its sum matches the target.
